context: Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) system for detecting and remediating CWE, CVE, and SANS Top 25 vulnerabilities at runtime in web applications. Internal application with business criticality level 3, targeting India and Singapore markets with data privacy and governance constraints.

userStories.title: Real-time Vulnerability Detection
userStories.iWantTo: automatically detect CWE, CVE, and SANS Top 25 vulnerabilities in real-time during application execution
userStories.soThat: I can identify and prevent security threats before they impact the system

acceptanceCriteria.given: the RASP agent is monitoring a web application
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CWE, CVE, or SANS Top 25 vulnerability is attempted
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system detects and logs the vulnerability within 100ms
all vulnerabilities are identified and prioritized by severity
the detection engine incorporates the new signature within 24 hours

userStories.title: Automated Threat Remediation
userStories.iWantTo: automatically remediate detected vulnerabilities without manual intervention
userStories.soThat: I can prevent security breaches and maintain system integrity

acceptanceCriteria.when: the remediation engine evaluates the threat

acceptanceCriteria.then: application functionality is preserved without breaking legitimate requests
the request is blocked and an alert is generated

userStories.title: Security Dashboard and Monitoring
userStories.iWantTo: view real-time security metrics and vulnerability trends through a dashboard
userStories.soThat: I can monitor system security posture and make informed decisions

acceptanceCriteria.then: I see real-time vulnerability counts, severity distribution, and trend charts

acceptanceCriteria.given: I need to investigate a security incident
acceptanceCriteria.when: I click on a vulnerability event
acceptanceCriteria.then: detailed information including payload, source IP, and remediation action is displayed
the dashboard updates automatically within 5 seconds

userStories.title: Compliance Reporting
userStories.iWantTo: generate compliance reports for India and Singapore regulatory requirements
userStories.soThat: I can demonstrate adherence to data protection and privacy regulations

acceptanceCriteria.given: security events have occurred over a period
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report is generated containing incident summaries, response times, and remediation actions

acceptanceCriteria.given: personal data processing events are detected
acceptanceCriteria.then: data privacy requirements are respected and sensitive information is masked
reports include all required fields for India and Singapore regulations

userStories.title: Alert and Notification System
userStories.iWantTo: receive immediate notifications for critical security events
userStories.soThat: I can respond quickly to potential security breaches

acceptanceCriteria.when: the threat level exceeds the defined threshold
acceptanceCriteria.then: immediate notifications are sent via email, SMS, and dashboard alert
alerts are de-duplicated and prioritized to prevent spam
alerts are delivered within 30 seconds using the configured channels

userStories.title: Configuration Management
userStories.iWantTo: configure RASP policies, thresholds, and remediation rules
userStories.soThat: I can customize the system behavior to match organizational security requirements

acceptanceCriteria.given: I need to modify security policies
acceptanceCriteria.then: I can update detection rules, remediation actions, and alert thresholds
changes take effect within 60 seconds without system restart

acceptanceCriteria.when: I attempt to save policy changes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system validates the configuration and provides clear error messages

errorAndEdgeCases: Network connectivity loss between RASP agent and central management system
High volume attack scenarios overwhelming the detection engine
False positive detection leading to blocking legitimate user requests
Database corruption affecting vulnerability signature updates
Memory exhaustion during heavy attack scenarios
Configuration conflicts between multiple policy rules
Timezone handling for compliance reporting across India and Singapore
SSL/TLS certificate expiration affecting secure communications
Concurrent access conflicts during policy updates
Data retention limits causing loss of historical security data
assumptions: Web applications will integrate the RASP agent through standard APIs
Network infrastructure supports real-time communication between agents and management system
Vulnerability databases (NIST, MITRE) are accessible for regular updates
System administrators have appropriate permissions to configure security policies
Compliance requirements for India and Singapore remain stable during implementation
Application performance impact from RASP monitoring is acceptable (<5% overhead)
Development teams will follow secure coding practices alongside RASP deployment
Infrastructure supports horizontal scaling for high-volume environments
openQuestions: What is the acceptable performance overhead threshold for production systems?
Which specific India and Singapore compliance frameworks must be supported?
How should the system handle applications with existing security tools?
What is the required data retention period for security events and logs?
Should the system support on-premises, cloud, or hybrid deployment models?
What integration capabilities are needed with existing SIEM and SOC tools?
How should the system handle legacy applications that cannot be easily modified?
What are the specific backup and disaster recovery requirements?
Should the system support multi-tenant configurations for different business units?
What training and documentation requirements exist for security operations teams?

traceability.notes: Core vulnerability detection functionality with real-time processing requirements
Automated remediation system with fallback blocking mechanism
Real-time dashboard with detailed incident investigation capabilities
Compliance reporting for India and Singapore regulatory requirements
Multi-channel notification system with de-duplication and prioritization
Dynamic configuration management with validation and real-time updates

tasks: Implement SANS Top 25 signature matching engine
Unit tests for detection engine components

Unit test coverage ≥90% with all tests passing
Performance benchmarks meet <5% application overhead requirement
Security penetration testing completed with no critical vulnerabilities
Documentation updated including API documentation and user guides
Deployment scripts and configuration tested in staging environment
Compliance requirements validated for India and Singapore regulations
Monitoring and alerting configured for production deployment

Sprint 3-4: Automated remediation system and policy engine (US-2)
Sprint 5: Security dashboard and real-time monitoring (US-3)

Sprint 11: Production deployment preparation and documentation
